action_text: Check idle energy and separate running, waiting, standby and fault states.
For ovens/autoclaves, check loading efficiency, heat-up time, door openings and cycle batching.
For vacuum infusion, check vacuum leaks, pump sizing and unnecessary pump running time.
For CNC/trimming, check tool path efficiency, extraction running time and batch scheduling.
Replace assumed design energy baselines with measured averages after several production runs.
Do not change cure or pressure parameters without engineering validation.
